bullets.text: Five special police teams have launched a manhunt for the culprits in Thiruthani following the murder of a cinema theatre employee.
Two construction workers died in separate electrocution incidents in Nanganallur and Ambattur, while another worker sustained burn injuries.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the 14.6-kilometer Chennai Metro Phase II stretch from Poonamallee to Vadapalani.
The High Court granted permission for DMK to file a Rs 1.01 crore defamation suit against ministers Aadhav Arjuna, Nirmal Kumar, and the TVK IT wing.
A complaint has been filed with the Election Commission alleging that TVK candidates heavily overspent on Vijay's roadshow in violation of rules.
At least 140 locations across Chennai will experience a five-hour power cut on Wednesday, October 7.
An IIT Madras-led study found that atmospheric aerosols can help improve extreme-rainfall and urban-flood forecasts for Chennai.
The Tamil Nadu government announced that about 5,000 volunteers have registered for flood mitigation and disaster works for the upcoming monsoon.
Residents and women in Ponneri protested by besieging the block development office to demand clean drinking water and 100 days of work.
The Ponneri court cancelled the bail of notorious rowdy Danasekar, who was involved in a protection money extortion case in Minjur.
Residents submitted a petition to the Thiruvallur Collector opposing the proposed setting up of a red soil quarry in Ramadandalam lake.
The Tamil Nadu government transferred three IAS officers, making key administrative changes in town panchayats, e-Governance, and ELCOT.
Nasscom is organizing a nationwide workshop series in collaboration with MeitY on DPDPA readiness and operationalization for the IT-ITeS industry.
Minister Aadhav Arjuna defended TVK candidate Sathiyabhama against a viral AI-generated video controversy during the Dharapuram bypoll campaign.
Minister Aadhav Arjuna dismissed the morphed video targeting TVK candidate Sathiyabhama as an AI creation and reacted strongly during public interactions.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister Vijay are set to travel together on the newly inaugurated Chennai Metro train.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Chennai on the 11th to launch the Poonamallee-Vadapalani metro rail service and dedicate the Vellore airport.
